scope: All saved pipeline_state records whose current status is completed, each six-stage matrix; parent meters and separate same-simulation/prior/ensemble artifacts reconciled without aggregate cross-run addition. All runtime text logs within backend/logs and uploads pipelines/simulations/reports are marker-parsed once.

inventory.excluded_log_types: Hook chat/pre_tool_use/post_tool_use/notification JSON and private action/provider transcript payloads are inventoried by filename count only, not interpreted as runtime retries. SQLite/DB contents not queried.

runs.time_warning: Saved endpoints can be restamped on resume and are not exclusive busy/critical-path durations. Union removes overlap but does not prove occupied time.
runs.research_snapshot_additive_policy: May overlap current/cumulative parent meter; do not add by default.

stages.meter_scope: latest saved meter attempt only; cumulative earlier attempts are not split by stage
stages.cache_tokens_coverage: not separately recorded in saved meter
stages.retry_count_coverage: marker counts are not distinct physical retries
stages.log_coverage: owned log artifacts plus explicit-ID global markers
stages.marker_limit: Counts overlap and may include quoted errors or replayed text; not distinct requests, retries, or seconds of waste.

reports.additive_policy: do not add to parent without proven exclusion from cumulative meter

reference_reconciliation.policy: This parent has no cumulative attempts and explicit extra report IDs are absent from its meter. Main report local telemetry overlaps parent REPORT; do not add it. Aggregate research snapshot lacks request-level history, and graph/simulation/failure usage remains missing; this is not a proved actual-usage lower bound.

patterns.empty_response_mentions: empty (?:content|response|result)|返回空 content|返回空结果

log_matching.unit: physical lines matching each regex once; overlapping patterns are not summed
log_matching.global_attribution: Only literal known pipeline/simulation/report/graph IDs on the same physical line. No temporal nearest-run guesses. One shared artifact is parsed once; owner rows may reference it without additive totals.

limitations: No saved pipeline created after July 15, 2026 was found in this checkout. Current user report over 150M tokens/run and over six hours cannot be independently attributed without a specific newer run/artifact source.
Latest meter per-stage fields cannot distribute earlier cumulative attempts; research options may overlap retained cumulative counters. Missing is not zero.
Cache hit counts are application-level observations and do not provide provider cache-read/write token volumes or billed costs. No actual invoice/capacity claims.
Naive log timestamps are retained without timezone inference. Rotated filename dates are not event dates. Reused/recovered stage endpoints overlap; sums are not critical-path elapsed time.
No output quality scoring is inferred from volume, skipped chunks, or completed status. Success means saved pipeline completed, not that every child/section/evidence source succeeded.
All marker counts are diagnostic textual coverage, not uniquely attributable physical provider events.

current_source_verification.interpretation: Several ASTRA repairs exist only in the isolated implementation worktree. The original checkout lacks usage_ledger.py and differs in meter/LLM/orchestrator/bridge code. This audit does not prove which checkout an active service uses and does not deploy anything.

highest_value_safe_next_workflow_fix.recommendation: ASTRA-06: durable per-episode graph completion receipts and bounded episode deadlines
highest_value_safe_next_workflow_fix.why: GRAPH occupied 31,050.610534 seconds, 61.78% of the high-token reference run; 278/466 chunks were skipped. The latest two completed pipelines retain 36/79 and 20/91 skipped chunks. These counts are evidence loss/degradation markers, not proven all avoidable failures.
highest_value_safe_next_workflow_fix.current_mechanism: Concurrent graph batch gathers all episode results before returning under a graph lock. A timeout cancels unfinished work and releases the lock but withholds already committed episode receipts from the caller. GraphBuilder counts a thrown batch as entirely failed; incomplete GRAPH stages are rebuilt rather than resuming committed chunks.

reproduction.method: GraphitiRuntime._add_episodes_concurrent current implementation, cancellation via asyncio.wait_for; in-memory fake episode commits; no DB or provider
reproduction.limits: Demonstrates no delivery/reuse of partial success inside this batch method. Does not measure historical duplicate writes, actual DB dedup behavior, production cost or speedup.

highest_value_safe_next_workflow_fix.benefit_hypothesis: Retain verified completed extraction work, reduce repeat provider work after interruption, and improve visibility/completeness of evidence accepted downstream. No production savings percentage is established.
highest_value_safe_next_workflow_fix.dependency: Bind each receipt to effective graph, source-content hash, reference time, ontology/input identity and extraction policy. Coordinate with open ontology-input binding/owned downstream invalidation; never reuse receipts across stale ontology or shared forks.
acceptance: Two fast successes and one hung episode: receipts for successful commits become durable before timeout.
After restart with identical inputs, no extraction request is sent for verified committed episodes; only incomplete work resumes.
Changing ontology/content/reference-time/policy invalidates matching receipts before reuse.
Ambiguous write completion requires reconciliation; repeated replies do not duplicate nodes/edges or inflate coverage.
Preserve existing bounded retries, actor seed exact readback and public/private context boundaries.
Measure distinct physical calls per accepted chunk, successful receipt coverage, graph lock wait and graph wall time against the same synthetic schedule.

validation.note: Raw saved JSON was never written; only sanitized outputs and scripts in this external evidence directory.
